adjudication_summary: Worker-6 accepts this paper as publication-grade with cautions after bounded source re-review: primary XML/PDF/OA packet sources were reopened, Tables 2/3 support 45 activity/toxicity rows, linked database rows are reconciled or preserved with modification caveats, supplementary landing pages are nonblocking, and the prior rework ticket has no remaining blocking target.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, antimicrobial methods, haemolysis methods, Tables 1/2/3, Fig. 1/2 captions, results and conclusion sections

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text checked against XML for peptide labels, Tables 1/2/3, method descriptions, and results discussion

oa_package.coverage: OA NXML, PDF, and figure image members reviewed; Fig. 1 image used for peptide structure caveats

supplementary_assets.coverage: file -L showed all packet supplementary .bin assets dereference to HTML landing pages; PMC article metadata reports no true supplement, and all activity/toxicity rows needed for the blocker are in primary XML/PDF Tables 2/3

merged_database_rows.coverage: 45 DBAASP assay rows, 47 linked experiment/text rows, 5 literature rows, and sequence catalog caveats reconciled to primary-source locators

supplementary_assets.note: Packet supplementary .bin assets are HTML landing pages, not assay spreadsheets/PDFs; this is nonblocking because primary Table 2/3 evidence recovers the requested activity/toxicity values and PMC metadata indicates no true supplement.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet and final adjudication remain separate: packet extraction is complete-with-gaps because landing-page supplementary assets exist, but the owner-layer blocker was resolved from primary XML/PDF/OA/database evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Validator/file readiness is separate from publication-grade review; acceptance here is based on source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair and fresh strict gate reruns.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled DBAASP assay/literature rows and CAMP/dbAMP text rows against primary Tables 1/2/3 and Fig. 1. Empty multimer sequence fields and X placeholders are preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized cautions rather than normalized away.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the missing activity/toxicity layer by extracting all Table 2 MIC values and Table 3 hemolysis values with endpoints, raw values, units, target metadata, assay conditions, and primary locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 limits mechanism language to structure-activity and CD membrane-mimetic context; no direct permeabilization or molecular target mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_review: The prior rwk-complete-test-0001 issues are resolved and the stale manifest open-ticket state was closed during worker-6 re-review; remaining uncertainty is a nonblocking database chemistry/sequence representation caveat captured in caution_findings.

caution_findings.note: Several linked database rows use empty multimer sequence fields or X placeholders for disulfide-linked, lauroyl/ornithine-containing, and amidated structures; primary Fig. 1/Table 1 evidence is preserved instead of normalizing these records to standard amino-acid strings.

Packet supplementary .bin assets are HTML landing pages and structured supplementary tables are absent; activity/toxicity evidence needed for the gate is fully recoverable from primary XML/PDF Tables 2/3.
Mechanism claims are limited to structure-activity/CD context and do not promote MIC, hemolysis, or CD data to direct molecular mechanism evidence.
